title: Oracle Profile Change Event
description: Simulated CDC (change-data-capture) event published onto oracle.profile.changes. Represents a mutation to a subject's profile record. Immediately embedded into the RAG vector store by context-updater so the LLM chat endpoint ('The Oracle') always answers with fresh context.

subject_name.description: Name of the subject whose profile changed

subject_role.description: Role of the subject within the simulation

updated_value.description: New value for the updated field, in free text

note.description: One self-contained sentence describing the change, suitable to embed directly into a vector store as a RAG chunk

examples.note: Trinity's clearance level was upgraded to Zion-Command following her exfiltration of Neo from Machine City.
Cypher was flagged rogue after intercepted comms revealed contact with Agent Smith.
